import sys, time, random, cProfile, pstats, io
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/emicro-deps'); sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from syntax import parse
import compiler.compiler as C
SERVICES = [{'name': c, 'label': i + 1} for i, c in enumerate('ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP')]
cols = {s['name']: i for i, s in enumerate(SERVICES)}
k = 16
rng = random.Random(9)
def words(count, length):
    seen = set(); out = []
    while len(out) < count:
        w = ''.join(rng.choice('ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP') for _ in range(length))
        if w not in seen:
            seen.add(w); out.append(w)
    return out
trie = ' '.join('match(%s) allow;' % ','.join(w) for w in words(4090, 16))
drops = ' '.join('%s drop;' % a for a in ['contains(A,B)','endswith(C,D)','startswith(E,F)','contains(G,H)'])
rules, a, p = parse(trie + ' ' + drops)
expr = C.language(rules, cols)
t=time.perf_counter(); trans, acc = C.automaton(expr, k); t1=time.perf_counter()
print('automaton: %d states, %.2fs' % (len(trans), t1-t))
t=time.perf_counter(); cls = C.minimize(trans, acc); t2=time.perf_counter()
print('minimize: %.2fs, classes=%d' % (t2-t1, len(set(cls))))
t=time.perf_counter(); fl, rows = C.canonical(trans, acc, cls, k); t3=time.perf_counter()
print('canonical: %.2fs rows=%d' % (t3-t2, len(rows)))
pr = cProfile.Profile(); pr.enable()
trans, acc = C.automaton(expr, k)
cls = C.minimize(trans, acc)
pr.disable()
s = io.StringIO(); ps = pstats.Stats(pr, stream=s).sort_stats('cumulative'); ps.print_stats(12)
print(s.getvalue()[:2600])
EOF
